t: The Git Reset Gambit: Recovering a Botched Feature with an AI Partner
s: This article details the recovery process after a significant Git mistake while developing Pipulate's backup system. It highlights the use of AI as a strategic partner in 'git archeology,' emphasizing the shift towards simpler, more robust software design.
sub: AI-assisted Git history analysis and code recovery
Designing robust and simple backup/restore systems
Human-AI collaboration for complex development challenges
